description: This file defines an internal class TransactionalStateStorageProviderWrapper implementing ITransactionalStateStorage<TState>. It manages transactional state storage including loading, storing, and updating state, along with the associated data structures.

classes.name: TransactionalStateStorageProviderWrapper<TState>
classes.description: A wrapper for transactional state storage, managing load and store operations with concurrency control.

classes.name: TransactionalStateRecord<TState>
classes.description: Represents a record of transactional state including committed state, sequence ID, metadata, and pending states.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the current transactional state from storage.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Asynchronously stores the current transactional state with concurrency and transactional integrity checks.

methods.name: GetStateStorage
methods.description: Creates and returns a new StateStorageBridge instance for handling storage operations.
